verdict.rationale: SolidJS's own README points developers to an in-browser playground ('Try this code in our playground!'), and community reports mention a playground widget and runnable examples on the Solid site. That gives hands-on learning without local setup, but nothing documents a structured, guided interactive tutorial. Community users also reported the landing-page playground misbehaving and some site examples failing to load on Android Chrome. missing for 10: evidence of a guided step-by-step interactive tutorial (lessons, exercises, progression), first-party documentation of the tutorial experience, positive independent hands-on corroboration that it works reliably across browsers

support.subject: As a developer, I can try an in-browser interactive tutorial to learn the framework hands-on without any local setup
